description: Defines the DataTableManager class for managing bank reconciliation data table, including fetching transactions, formatting data, rendering table, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: DataTableManager
classes.description: Manages the display and interaction of bank reconciliation transactions in a data table.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the DataTableManager with options, sets up dialog manager, and creates the data table.

methods.name: make_dt
methods.description: Fetches bank transactions and initializes data table.

methods.name: get_dt_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the data table.

methods.name: format_data
methods.description: Formats raw transaction data into table rows.

methods.name: format_row
methods.description: Converts a transaction object into a table row array.

methods.name: get_datatable
methods.description: Creates and configures the data table UI component.

methods.name: set_listeners
methods.description: Sets event listeners for user interactions on the data table.

methods.name: update_dt_cards
methods.description: Updates transaction rows and balance cards after user actions.

methods.name: get_cleared_balance
methods.description: Fetches the cleared bank balance up to a specific date.
